bindings.source_value: arbitrary measurable functions of past responses

This model counts only oracle resources. Arithmetic, linear algebra, and storage applied to received responses are free. Any extra hidden-function gradient, HVP/JVP, value, or inner-solve response must be obtained through a declared, charged operation.

features.label: No additional span restriction explicitly imposed

bindings.source_value: Algorithms are deterministic and may use arbitrary measurable adaptive queries, stopping, and postprocessing. Outputs may be unqueried, deterministically selected historical points, or admissible averages. No span or zero-respecting restriction applies. Queries are sequential; each response in a batch is charged. Internal arithmetic, linear algebra, and storage are free, with no separate work, memory, or communication budget.

Output one outer point $\widehat{x}\in\mathbb{R}^{d_x}$. An inner solution, function value, or computable accuracy certificate is not required. Arbitrary admissible postprocessing and unqueried outputs are allowed.

Choose an algorithm using the public parameters, then require $\|\nabla\Phi(\widehat{x})\|_2\le\varepsilon$ for every admissible instance and oracle law. The guarantee is deterministic and applies instance by instance.
